subject: general
question: What was the capital of Hoyasala’s Kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dvarasamudra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The capital of Hoyasala’s Kingdom is **Dvarasamudra**.
 
• **Hoysalas** ruled in India from about 1006 to about 1346 ce in the southern Deccan and for a time in the Kaveri River valley.
 
• The capital of the Hoysalas was initially situated at Belur but was then moved to Halebidu, which is also known as **Dwarasamudra**.
 
• By the 13th century, they governed most of present-day **Karnataka**, parts of **Tamil Nadu **and parts of western** Andhra Pradesh** in Deccan India.
 
• The Hoysala rulers were originally from **Malenadu**, an elevated region in the Western Ghats.
 
• The Hoysala era was an important period in the development of art, architecture, and religion in **South India**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mysore**, a city in India's southwestern Karnataka state, was the capital of the Kingdom of Mysore from 1399 to 1947. 
 
• **Devagiri **city is located in Aurangabad district, Maharashtra. It was the capital city of the Yadava dynasty.
 
• **Kalyani** is a city and a municipality and Community Development Block of Nadia district in the Indian state of West Bengal.
